hooks.command: node -e "let d='';const MAX=1024*1024;process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');process.stdin.on('data',c=>{if(d.length<MAX){d+=c.substring(0,MAX-d.length)}});process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/(cmake --build.*&&.*\.\/|make.*&&.*\.\/|mpirun|mpiexec|srun)/.test(cmd)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Long-running process must run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s build \"cmake --build build\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t build');process.exit(2)}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

Auto-format C++ files with clang-format (Google style) after edits

hooks.command: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');let d='';const MAX=1024*1024;process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');process.stdin.on('data',c=>{if(d.length<MAX){d+=c.substring(0,MAX-d.length)}});process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&/\.(cpp|cc|cxx)$/.test(p)&&fs.existsSync(p)){try{const r=execSync('g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -fsyntax-only \"'+p+'\" 2>&1',{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe']});if(r.trim())console.error(r.trim())}catch(e){const out=(e.stdout||'')+(e.stderr||'');const lines=out.split('\n').filter(l=>l.includes('error')||l.includes('warning')).slice(0,10);if(lines.length)console.error(lines.join('\n'))}}}catch{}console.log(d)})"

PostToolUse.description: C++20 syntax check after editing .cpp/.cc/.cxx files

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';const MAX=1024*1024;process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');process.stdin.on('data',c=>{if(d.length<MAX){d+=c.substring(0,MAX-d.length)}});process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&/\.(cpp|hpp|cc|h|cxx|hxx)$/.test(p)&&fs.existsSync(p)){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const lines=c.split('\n');const matches=[];lines.forEach((l,idx)=>{if(/\bstd::cout\b|\bprintf\s*\(|\bfprintf\s*\(\s*stderr/.test(l))matches.push((idx+1)+': '+l.trim())});if(matches.length){console.error('[Hook] WARNING: Debug output found in '+p);matches.slice(0,5).forEach(m=>console.error(m));console.error('[Hook] Remove std::cout/printf/fprintf(stderr before committing')}}}catch{}console.log(d)})"
